text:
The median asking rent in the Rhein‑Erft district sits at 11.98 €/m², up 3.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.5 % over the past five years, placing the area 17th among the 37 most expensive cities. The market is tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.2 % and properties staying on the market for about 25 days; 26 % are let within a week.

Affordability remains constrained: the typical 60 m² unit costs 719 € per month, and the rent‑burden for two residents is 15.3 %. Asking rents command a 56 % premium over the 2022 existing rent of 7.67 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 12.77 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 12.41 €/m² and 13.13 €/m², a change of 6.6 % from today.
